description: MIAMI — The landscape of South Florida politics shifted irrevocably this week. title: DeSantis says Alligator Alcatraz is closed, TPS Status for Haitians REVOKED, as Haitian-American candidate Moe Dimanche Qualifies for Florida Governor race – No MOE Corruption
